args.description: For a package: the command's arguments. ${NAME} stays for the local gateway to fill from the machine, and $$ writes one $.

server_version.description: The version the server reported in initialize, when it reported one.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the package or binary.

server_version.description: The version the server reported in initialize, when it reported one.

document_hash.description: SHA-256 of the definition's bytes as committed, or of the bundle for many files.

commit.description: The commit ref resolved to when the lock was written.

in.description: Where an API key goes. api_key only.

name.description: The header, query parameter, or cookie that carries an API key. api_key only.

authorization_url.description: oauth2: the authorization code flow's authorizationUrl.

token_url.description: oauth2: the tokenUrl of the authorization code or client credentials flow.

refresh_url.description: oauth2: the refreshUrl, when it differs from token_url.

scopes.description: oauth2 and openIdConnect: the scopes the flow offers.

security_schemes.description: OpenAPI only: components.securitySchemes as import read them, so compile resolves auth.scheme without the document.

in.description: Where an API key goes. api_key only.

name.description: The header, query parameter, or cookie that carries an API key. api_key only.

authorization_url.description: oauth2: the authorization code flow's authorizationUrl.

token_url.description: oauth2: the tokenUrl of the authorization code or client credentials flow.

refresh_url.description: oauth2: the refreshUrl, when it differs from token_url.

scopes.description: oauth2 and openIdConnect: the scopes the flow offers.

apply.description: What the scheme means: from the lock for OpenAPI, or from the scheme's name.

auth.description: Null when the mode is none or the local gateway runs the server. Each environment names its credential.

sandbox.description: True for the one environment every agent's calls go to: the one marked sandbox, or the only one.

url.description: Absent for a server the local gateway runs.

request.description: What each model request pays: the definitions, or the three search tools.

inputSchema.description: A JSON Schema whose type is object.

outputSchema.description: A JSON Schema whose type is object.

search.description: The search, describe, and call definitions in search mode. Null in direct mode.

inputSchema.description: A JSON Schema whose type is object.

outputSchema.description: A JSON Schema whose type is object.

tokens.description: The definition's tokens, counted with countTokens over its RFC 8785 form.

rename.description: Upstream name to the name the agent sees.

deadline_ms.description: Every send has one. 30,000 unless tools.toml sets deadline_ms.

tool.description: The name tools/call sends: the server's own name.

operation.description: The operationId, or "POST /refunds/{id}/cancel" when the operation has none.

path.description: The path template, relative to the environment's url.

name.description: The parameter's name as the API spells it.

property.description: The inputSchema property that carries the value.

style.description: OpenAPI's serialization style, when it differs from the default for `in`.

parameters.description: Parameters a security scheme names are never here.

properties.description: The inputSchema properties that make up the body.

property.description: The inputSchema property that carries the body: body.

status.description: The response the outputSchema describes: 200, 201, or 2XX.

wrap.description: An array response arrives as { items }, because MCP requires an object result.

response.description: Absent when no 2xx response has a JSON schema.

security.description: The operation's security requirements, as OpenAPI writes them. The gateway adds these.

type.description: The argument's type as the operation declares its variable.

property.description: The inputSchema property that carries the value.

selection.description: The generated selection set, to depth 2. tools.toml's selection replaces it. Absent for a scalar field.

streaming.description: A server-streaming result is { items, truncated }. Client and bidirectional streams never become tools.

request.description: The upstream template, with tools.toml's GraphQL selection applied.

input.description: The input that carries the cursor, page, or offset: cursor, page, after.

next.description: Where the result holds the next cursor: next_cursor, pageInfo.endCursor.

has_more.description: Where the result says more pages remain: has_more, pageInfo.hasNextPage.

items.description: The array the pages add to: data, edges.

limit.description: The input that sets the page size.

descriptor_set.description: gRPC only: the FileDescriptorSet the executor encodes and decodes with.

servers.description: One entry per server folder, ordered by name.

description: The compiled tools of one published steering version, which the bundle carries and the cloud gateway serves.
